text: `mean` sums and divides — two operations. Why does it still do one job?
choices: Both serve one purpose, at one level of abstraction, that a caller thinks of as one action
It does not; it should be split
Because it has one return statement
explanation: The count of operations is not the criterion. saveAndEmail also has two operations and clearly does two jobs, because persisting and notifying are separate concerns a caller might want independently — and because the name needs 'and'.
